text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Right. 
My preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Lady Big, are your preparations in order? 
Let us make our way to breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Yep! All ready to go on my end—

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, hold on! 
Look at that refreshed face! Groomed to 
absolute perfection!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
You take first prize again today for the 
'Impeccable Since Morning Award'! 
As expected of Phaleno-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
The way you hold your chopsticks is so 
graceful! Your posture is straight! 
And there's not a single bit of meat left 
on the fish bones!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
That makes you a repeat winner 
for the 'Cleanest Breakfast Eater Award'!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you are too kind.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a lovely bath.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it seems my loofah toner is running 
low. 
I will have to buy some more.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! 
A double win for the 'Wonderfully Smooth 
and Hydrated Skin Award' 
and the 'Flawless Daily Skincare Award'!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Lady Big, the tea is ready. 
Please, enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuu! Your tea is always 
so wonderfully mellow, I love it!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
And the way you hold your teacup is so 
graceful, too! 
...Ehehe, seriously, everything about you 
is worthy of praise, Phaleno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You do me far too much honor.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: However, Lady Big—

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
When you shower my every single move 
with such relentless praise, morning and 
night...

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: ...And then?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I cannot help but be thoroughly 
impressed.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The way you constantly discover virtues 
within someone as inexperienced as myself, 
day after day...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
An observant eye that never misses the 
slightest gesture, 
and a gracious heart eager to celebrate 
beauty wherever it is found—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Such height is impossible to reach without 
possessing both. 
That, above all else, is a virtue truly 
worthy of praise.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Presumptuous though it may be, allow me to 
present you with one. 
—The 'Master of Praise Award.'

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! I'm so haaaappy! 
Thanks for the award~~♪

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I only compliment you because 
you're already so amazing, though!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute! 
I feel like you gave me that award 
yesterday, too!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Both yesterday and today, 
your praise was more than worthy of 
receiving it.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! If that's the case, you deserve 
a 'Master of Praise Award' too, 
Phaleno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis & Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. 
...Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was walking through the academy, 
I heard cheerful voices echoing from up 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Phaleno-chaaaan! 
I heard you carried the handouts for class 
in place of the teacher! 
That's so great of you!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I merely had business in the staff room. 
It was on my way.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Wait, could that be about the part 
you were stuck on with yesterday's 
homework? 
Going right away to ask is way too 
admirable!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. 
What a pleasant coincidence.
choice_data_list: Keep up the good work on your studies!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Every single day, 
she pays me such close attention.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Consistency is no easy feat. 
Yet Lady Big carries it out effortlessly.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You just praised Big-san, didn't you? 
That earns you the 'Master of Returning 
Praise Award'!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. 
Fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Way to go!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Jumping in to cheer someone on in a 
heartbeat! 
That's just so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Phaleno-chan and Trainer! 
A double award!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...And so it seems. 
Shall we accept with gratitude?
